mainEntity.name: What is included in a metal building shell?

acceptedAnswer.text: A metal building shell includes the primary structural steel frame, secondary framing like purlins and girts, metal roof panels, exterior wall panels, trim, and weatherproofing fasteners. It creates a fully enclosed, weather-tight structure. The shell package typically excludes interior buildouts such as framing partitions, drywall, plumbing, electrical wiring, HVAC, and finished flooring. Opting for a shell-only build allows you to secure an exterior structure quickly while managing the interior fit-out in phases as your budget and scheduling permit.
acceptedAnswer.description: A metal building shell includes the structural steel framing, roof panels, wall siding, trim, and fasteners to form a weather-tight exterior, excluding interior fit-outs.
